Non-cryptographic PRNG state, integer and float generators, rolls, and secure byte fill.

# Purpose
`fd_rng.h` defines a small header-only pseudo random number generator API for non-cryptographic use. It stores the generator state in `fd_rng_t`, which keeps a sequence value and an index, and it uses `fd_ulong_hash` to produce a deterministic random stream with support for random access, multiple parallel sequences, and state save and restore. The file also provides helpers to create, join, leave, and delete the state object, plus functions to return unsigned and signed integers, floating-point values, bounded rolls, and several distribution-based values such as exponential and normal outputs. It is a C++-compatible interface intended to be imported by other code, not an executable, and it also includes `fd_rng_secure` for reading cryptographically secure bytes from the platform when needed.
